exposure: Combination of magnesium sulfate and beta-2 adrenergic agonists
outcome: Poor perinatal outcome (infant death, brain damage, cerebral palsy, developmental delay)
cohort: 1083 infants born between 28 and 36 weeks gestation
finding: Antenatal magnesium sulfate administration was associated with a decreased incidence of poor perinatal outcomes in preterm infants, while the combination of magnesium sulfate and beta-2 adrenergic agonists diminished this neuroprotective effect.
